verdict.rationale: OpenClaw exposes multiple official build surfaces — an MCP server/client interface, a CLI, a Gateway HTTP API (OpenAI-compatible chat completions and tools-invoke endpoints), skills/plugins via ClawHub, and an A2A agent protocol — which together let AI-native users build integrations, but there is no evidence of a dedicated, versioned 'official SDK' (e.g., a Python/JS client library) and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, suggesting no formal SDK/spec artifact exists. missing for 10: an explicit official SDK package/library (Python, JS, etc.), a published OpenAPI/spec document, and independent developer corroboration of building against these APIs.
